notes.title: Playtest Update 2
notes.content:
- Polish "Alden Forest"
- Fixed an Issue with Boss Door in "Grappling Hook" Room.
- Fixed Snail Cutscene, schloss sich zu spät.
- Adjusted Wizard start statss.
- Adjusted some special attacks timer.
- Fixed staff name.
- Split stagger and force chance for weapons, needed for furhter runes/passives.

notes.title: Playtest Update
notes.content:
- "Sewerage Key" quest has been moved to avoid overwhelming new players in the tavern.
- Earth Barrage should no longer hang.
- "Alden Forest" boss now only drops max Diamond "Gold"
- "Alden Forest" boss door should be fixed.
- "Orb of Retreat" is now consumed.
- The size of some effect sprites has been adjusted.
- Overworld location text now closes when selecting a location.
- Coins should no longer get stuck in the ceiling.
- The bartender in the "Drunken Snake" now explains the "Lost Item Chest"
- The city 'Murglen' has been finally renamed to "Isendor".
- Mount is now available as a reward from the "Alden Forest" quest
